title: Use System API action “System Startup” to start the system when in shutdown state
summary: Use the System API action labeled “System Startup” to start the OptiSweep system when the system is currently in a shutdown state, then confirm the system state has moved out of shutdown using “System State”.
when_to_use: When the system is in a shutdown state and you need to start it using the System API action “System Startup”.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the System API action “System Startup” and verify the system state using “System State”.
access_or_tools_needed: System API interface that exposes the “System Startup” action
System API interface that exposes “System State” for confirmation

access_required: Access to the System API interface that provides “System Startup” and “System State”
system_preconditions: System is currently in a shutdown state (so that “System Startup” is applicable)

visual_references.description: Frame showing the System API actions list including “System Startup” and “System State”.

steps.title: Identify the System API action labeled “System Startup”
steps.purpose: Ensure you are using the correct System API action intended to start the system from shutdown.
steps.instruction: In the System API interface, locate the action/control labeled “System Startup”.
steps.expected_result: The “System Startup” action/control is identified and ready to run in the System API interface.
steps.healthy_condition: You can clearly see the “System Startup” label in the System API actions list.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot find the “System Startup” action label or you are unsure which control corresponds to it.

actions.label: Locate System Startup action
actions.exact_action: Identify the System API action labeled “System Startup”.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot locate “System Startup”, stop and escalate (the source does not provide alternate recovery steps).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “System startup will start up the system if it's in a shutdown state.”

steps.title: Run “System Startup” to start the system if it is in a shutdown state
steps.purpose: Start the system from shutdown using the intended conditional action.
steps.instruction: Execute the System API action “System Startup”. Only run it when the system is in a shutdown state.
steps.expected_result: The system transitions from shutdown toward started/running operation (as implied by the conditional behavior of “System startup”).
steps.healthy_condition: After running “System Startup”, the system is no longer in shutdown when checked via “System State” in the next step.
steps.failure_condition: After running “System Startup”, the system remains in shutdown (or does not transition as expected).

actions.label: Execute System Startup
actions.exact_action: Run “System Startup” to start the system if it is in a shutdown state.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the system does not start as expected, stop and escalate (no additional recovery steps are provided in the source).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “System startup will start up the system if it's in a shutdown state.”

steps.title: Confirm the system is no longer in shutdown state using “System State”
steps.purpose: Verify that the startup action had the intended effect by checking the current system state.
steps.instruction: Use the System API interface to run “System State” and confirm the system state is no longer shutdown.
steps.expected_result: “System State” indicates the system is not in shutdown anymore.
steps.healthy_condition: The “System State” output reflects a state consistent with the system having started (i.e., not shutdown).
steps.failure_condition: “System State” still indicates shutdown after running “System Startup”.

actions.label: Query System State
actions.exact_action: After running, confirm the system is no longer in shutdown state by checking “System State”.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the system does not start as expected (System State still shows shutdown), stop and escalate (the source does not provide additional recovery steps).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “System state will get the current state of the system…” and “System startup will start up the system if it's in a shutdown state.”
“System State returns the current state of the system. System Startup is for a shutdown state.”

success_criteria: After executing “System Startup”, “System State” indicates the system is no longer in shutdown state.
healthy_conditions: “System State” reflects a current system state consistent with the system having started (not shutdown).
failure_conditions: “System State” still indicates shutdown after running “System Startup”.
The system does not transition from shutdown toward started/running operation after “System Startup”.
escalation_guidance: If the system does not start as expected, stop and escalate. The source does not provide additional recovery steps beyond using “System Startup” and confirming with “System State”.
